subject: general
question:
Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence and select its correct spelling from the given options.

The committee heard that he had been negliegent in his duty.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"negliegent"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"negligent"**, which means failing to take proper care in doing something. (लापरवाह)

 
 
• **Example:** The doctor was found negligent in his duties towards the patient.
 
 
 
• **"Negligent"** is the correct form and means failing to take proper care in doing something. (लापरवाह)
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher was negligent in grading the students' papers on time.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Hurd** (गलत वर्तनी): The correct spelling is **"heard"** (सुना).

 
 
• **Example:** I heard the news about the accident yesterday.
 
 
 
• **Dutie** (गलत वर्तनी): The correct spelling is **"duty"** (कर्तव्य).
 
 
• **Example:** It is your duty to report any suspicious activity.
 
 
 
• **Comittee** (गलत वर्तनी): The correct spelling is **"committee"** (समिति).
 
 
• **Example:** The committee will meet next week to discuss the budget.
 
 

Therefore, the correct spelling is** 'negligent.'**
